answer: Every claim climbs the trellis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the inlet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
